Jordan — thanks for the ping and the context. Quick initial read and suggested next steps (high level):

1) Liability / indemnity / cap: propose we move to a single-dollar cap equal to 12 months of committed fees but carve out willful misconduct and gross negligence for indemnity. For OSS carveout: accept limited OSS carveout but exclude third-party claims arising from our modifications.

2) Data residency / processing: draft a short residency addendum (US only) and propose standard DP terms (subprocessor list, data return/deletion, export controls). Ask: confirm whether ClearPort will insist on contractual residency guarantees or just operational controls.

3) SLA / incident credits: Acceptable to offer uptime SLA with tiered credits; will propose Exhibit B language that ties credits to incident severity.

4) IP: keep Redwood ownership of platform/IP; license back for customer use only. Add clarity around customer-provided data / models.

5) Billing / PO: procurement requiring PO prior to signature is normal; ops should flag the billing contact and whether we need net-30 versus net-45. We'll insert an invoicing clause to accommodate PO workflows.

Action plan: I'll generate a redlined MSA and a one-page summary of the key negotiation points. Rishi — can you handle the data residency addendum draft?

Deliverable timeline: redline + summary uploaded to the shared drive link by COB 12/11 (I will assign to Contracts and upload to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz/onboarding-clearport).

If anyone on the team wants to push a narrower cap or accept different SLA terms, speak up — otherwise I'll proceed with the above.
